OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

All tests pass. Here's a summary of the change.

## What I implemented

`POST /api/owners` now assigns each new owner a `customerCode` formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (e.g. `SMI-0007`), where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence one greater than the current owner count.

## Files changed

- **`Owner.java`** — added a `customerCode` field (`@Column(name = "customer_code")`) with getter/setter.
- **`AssignCustomerCode.java`** (new) — a single-responsibility OfficeFloor step that reads the built `Owner` via `@Val`, computes the prefix from the last name, derives the sequence as `ownerRepository.findAll().size() + 1`, and sets the code. It runs *before* `SaveOwner`, so the count excludes the owner being created.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new step into the pipeline between `defaultRegistrationDate` and `save`, under the same `transaction` governance.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `customerCode` as a `readOnly` property on the `Owner` response schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it (MapStruct maps it by name in `toOwnerDto`), and it surfaces on `GET /api/owners/{id}`.
- **Schema SQL** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `postgres`, `mysql`) — added a `customer_code` column to the `owners` table.

## Design notes

- The sequence being count-based makes it global and monotonic across owners; because the step runs pre-save and Hibernate auto-flushes before the `findAll()` query, a just-created owner is included in the next owner's count — so consecutive creates increment by exactly 1, as the test asserts.
- Logic lives in its own small step class rather than being bolted onto `BuildOwner` or `SaveOwner`, keeping each function single-purpose and reusing the existing `OwnerRepository`.

Test result: `AcceptanceTest` (and the full suite) → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
